# Sandgate Family Dental

> A comprehensive family dental practice in Sandgate offering general, restorative, cosmetic, and pediatric dental care with bulk billing options.

Sandgate Family Dental, led by Dr Nima Kancherla and Dr Nina Stallman, serves the Sandgate area and surrounding suburbs including Shorncliffe, Deagon, Brighton, Taigum, Boondall, Bracken Ridge, and Fitzgibbon. The practice provides preventive, restorative, cosmetic, and emergency dental services with a focus on family-friendly care and Medicare/CDBS bulk billing.
